From: alex_martinez@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Demo — OpenLib / GitHub integration (pre-read)

Hi Jordan and Morgan — thanks for scheduling. Quick pre-read:

- Auth options: 1) GitHub App (recommended for orgs) — supports repo-level installs and granular perms; 2) PAT (personal access token) — fine for early testing but not ideal long-term.
- Secrets & KMS: We support bringing your own KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) and can show how to rotate keys used by Actions.
- Streaming: You can stream partial generation results back to an Actions job via a webhook endpoint or publish tokens to an artifact; we’ll demo a small workflow.

If you have a public repo that demonstrates your CI, feel free to share the link prior to the call and I’ll tailor the demo. Otherwise, I’ll demo with a small sample repo.

See you shortly —
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
